reviewScope.summary: M02 product presentation, source alignment, exercise identity and visual models; exact candidate hosted verification still required.
evidence: Compared the uploaded seven-module source with the pinned SHA-256 70438bd924141500ebb636b69f74a578f58c1b37f7a152fa073349bce50b60bb.

Inspected the existing Git teaching renderer, M02 curriculum and 139 exercises. Replayed the recorded M02 authoring DSL cache; the 63 initial revision targets matched the pinned source. Full external producer regeneration not performed.
Verified all 86 product presentation fields and all 21 visual anchors against the unchanged packaged M02 JSON. Corrected duplicate card labels in two diagrams.

Scoped implementation uses the same renderer in both shells; exercise feedback and hints are applied only to their presentation, not evaluation or storage. Added source-binding, nonmutation, renderer interaction and browser journey tests; not executed locally.

adversarialFindings.description: Editing an exported exercise's prose changes its content hash and can make earlier correct answers stale.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Use an exact-source-bound presentation-only layer; keep evaluator inputs, IDs, packaged assets, hashes and persistence unchanged.

adversarialFindings.description: Two visual frames repeated labels used as React keys.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Use distinct descriptive labels and assert their uniqueness in the focused test.

adversarialFindings.description: Full external producer reproduction requires the frozen historic skill graph, absent in the provided archive.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Do not regenerate or claim a canonical external authoring export. Product presentation is a scoped overlay on the verified existing export; preserve every source asset. Future source revision can retire exact-matched overrides.

adversarialFindings.description: Build size, browser behaviour and complete release check not measured in this chat environment.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Submit the exact candidate to the unchanged hosted release gate; merge only after required checks pass and no material issue remains.

retrospective.summary: Scoped source-level review supports submission to the existing hosted release gate, not a declaration of a successful build or production readiness.
